 India is currently on an all-format tour where they are scheduled to play five T20Is, five ODIs and two Test matches,

 India's record in the country in the shortest format is mixed, with wins, losses, Super Overs, and a washout. Looking at the full numbers gives a clearer idea of how the Men in Blue have performed against the Kiwis away from home.

 Has India won a T20 series in New Zealand?
 India have lifted the trophy twice on New Zealand soil: once with a 5-0 sweep in 2019/20, and again with a 1-0 result in 2022/23.
 The earlier of those remains the lone five-match T20I series hosted there, and it required Super Overs to settle two of its fixtures. The later one ran to three matches, though rain wiped out one of them and another finished level.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Black Caps, for their part, have taken three series against India, in 2008/09, 2012 and 2018/19, and the 2012 triumph is the only one that came on Indian soil.
 India have not surrendered a home series since that point, claiming each of them in 2017/18, 2021/22, January 2023 and 2025/26. In fact, the 2018/19 defeat is the last series India have lost anywhere against this opponent, as they have won all five that followed.
 India vs. New Zealand T20I head-to-head record overall
 Across all T20Is, India hold the advantage. The two teams have played 33 matches, with India winning 19, New Zealand 11, and three ending in ties.

 India vs. New Zealand T20I record in India
 India have been very hard to beat at home. In 17 meetings, they have won 12 and lost five, which works out to a win rate of roughly 71 per cent. That count includes two World Cup games: New Zealand's win in Nagpur in March 2016 and India's 96-run victory in the 2026 final.
